# lab-delivery

Folds what each cluster said about applying into one arrangement for the lab.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

## Provides

| provision | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| step | [LAB_STEPS](../signatures/LAB_STEPS.md) | Plan steps a floe contributes, keyed by step name. |

## Emits

| alias | kind | what it carries |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cd | catallaxy.cd | How the lab's manifests reach its clusters, and the root Application that hands one over. |

## What it emits

Rendered by `every-floe` as the lab unit `delivery`. A unit of the lab
installs nothing into a cluster, and its provisions are sealed inside the
lab's inclusion — so its declaration above is its interface.

## Output kinds

| kind | entries |
| --- | --- |
| catallaxy.cd | bootstrap, git, perCluster, rootApplication |
